info.name: E-Commerce Microservices API
info.description:
Complete API collection for the E-Commerce Microservices Platform.

**Base URL:** http://localhost:3000 (API Gateway)

All requests go through the API Gateway which handles JWT authentication, role-based authorization, and proxies to individual services.

---

## Authentication Flow
1. Register → POST /api/auth/register
2. Verify Phone → POST /api/auth/verify-phone
3. Login → POST /api/auth/login → Copy `accessToken` from response
4. Set `accessToken` as Authorization: Bearer <token> header

## Role-Based Access
- **Public:** Product listing, Auth endpoints
- **USER:** Cart, Orders, Payments, Profile
- **ADMIN:** Product CRUD, Order management

---

**Services:** Auth (3001) · User (3002) · Product (3003) · Order (3004) · Cart (3005) · Payment (3006) · Notification (event-driven)

item.name: 🛒 Cart
item.description: Shopping cart management. All endpoints require authentication. Proxied through gateway at /api/cart.

request.description: Add a product to the user's cart. If the product already exists in the cart, quantity is updated.
Get the current user's cart with all items and total price. Cached in Redis.
Update the quantity of a specific item in the cart.
Remove a specific product from the cart.
Remove all items from the cart. Also triggered automatically after an order is placed.

item.name: 📋 Orders
item.description: Order management. Creating an order triggers the outbox pattern: stock reduction (Product Service), cart clearing (Cart Service), and payment initiation (Payment Service) via RabbitMQ events.

request.description: Create a new order. Payment methods: UPI, CARD, NET_BANKING, WALLET. This triggers the outbox pattern which publishes events to Product, Cart, Payment, and Notification services.

query.description: Filter by status: PENDING, CONFIRMED, SHIPPED, DELIVERED, CANCELLED

request.description: Get paginated list of orders. Optionally filter by order status.
Get a single order by its ID.
Admin only. Update order status. Valid statuses: PENDING, CONFIRMED, SHIPPED, DELIVERED, CANCELLED.
Admin only. Permanently delete an order.

item.name: 💳 Payments
item.description: Payment processing via Razorpay. Supports UPI, Card, Net Banking, and Wallet. Includes client-side verification and server-side webhook handling.

request.description: Get payment details by payment ID.
Get the payment record associated with a specific order.
Get all payments made by a specific user.
Client-side payment verification. Called from the frontend after Razorpay checkout success. Verifies the HMAC signature and updates payment status.

Razorpay server-side webhook. Called by Razorpay on payment events. Verifies the webhook signature, then publishes PAYMENT_SUCCESS or PAYMENT_FAILED events via RabbitMQ to Order and Notification services.
